regions.name: Cobb County
regions.model_scope: Cobb County independent 2024–25 grade-school models use exact NCES LEA 1301290 / native GA-633 identities. All 90 operational pure lower offered and reconciled enrolled grade profiles remain searchable, with separate fixed 90-school Math, ELA and Combined models. Outcomes use original regular Georgia Milestones EOG All Students G38 Levels 3–4 published rates; income uses each school’s own reported individual direct certification divided by reported same-year membership. Primary-only, high and mixed configurations remain outside. Income extremes and influence remain included. Georgia Medicaid/foster certification and outside-program prekindergarten membership are broader population limits. Accelerated EOG/EOC coverage, nonlisted attribution completeness, valid-score counts and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable.
regions.map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Cobb County source release.
